name: AI Decorator
description: Decorate a selected structure with one tap using offline styles, or describe a look and let AI do it.

api-key.name: Gemini API Key
api-key.description: Your free Gemini API key from <cy>aistudio.google.com/apikey</c> (no payment needed). Only needed for typed prompts; the style buttons work offline. Requests go straight from your game to Google; the key is stored only in your Geode save folder.

model.name: Model
model.description: Gemini model ID. Flash and Flash-Lite models are on the free tier; switch to <cy>gemini-3.5-flash-lite</c> if you hit limits.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Upper limit on how many decoration objects the AI may place in one generation.

color-channel-start.name: Style Color Channels
color-channel-start.description: Offline styles use 5 color channels starting at this one (outline, glow, fill, background, details). Pick a range your level doesn't use.

palette.name: Object Palette
palette.description: Optional list of object IDs the AI should prefer, as <cy>id:description</c> pairs separated by commas (e.g. <cy>1:basic block, 8:spike</c>). Leave empty to let the AI pick from the IDs it knows plus the ones in your selection.
